content: For the set of users in $P$, the total number of changes in these 5 profile attributes over 61 snapshots is 974. Figure FIGREF12 shows the distribution of profile changes for specific attributes over all the 61 snapshots. The most changed attribute among the political handles is the profile image followed by display name. In the same Figure, there is a sharp increase in the number of changes to the display name attribute on 23rd May, 2019. The increase is because @narendramodi removed Chowkidar from the display name of his Twitter handle which resulted in many other political handles doing the same. Another interesting trend is that none of the handles changed their username over all the snapshots. This could be attributed to the fact that Twitter discourages a change of usernames for verified accounts as the verified status might not remain intact after the change BIBREF8.
